encounters.cc: Enrollment in crossover clinical trial for refractory chronic migraine

lines: Enrollment in crossover clinical trial for refractory chronic migraine

This 32-year-old female with major depressive disorder, chronic migraine, irritable bowel syndrome, epilepsy, and factitious disorder imposed on self returns following gastroenterology and emergency encounters for trial enrollment.
She has been experiencing 15 headache days per month for the past year.
The trial involves the patient taking the new medication for 3 months and then switching to a placebo for another 3 months, without knowing the order.
The patient's headache frequency is recorded monthly.
The patient reports no significant side effects during the trial.
